spans.s:
बैडाल a. (ली f.) [बिडालस्येदं अण्]
1 Relating to a cat.
--2 Peculiar to
cats.
--Comp.
--व्रतं ‘a cat-like
observance,’ concealing one's malice
or evil designs under the garb of
piety or virtue.
--व्रतिः one who
[]
leads a chaste life simply from
want of female company (and not
because he has controlled his
senses).
--व्रतिकः, --व्रतिन् m. a religious
hypocrite, an impostor.
